name: pont-claude-code
description: Bridge a Claude chat (Claude Desktop) and Claude Code: delegate, follow, answer questions, get results — no copy-paste.

scripts.test: node --test test/unit.mjs && node test/e2e.mjs && npm run build && PONT_SERVER=dist/index.mjs node test/e2e.mjs
scripts.build: esbuild server/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --minify --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
